name: La Casa de Norma
tagline: We are rebuilding a house. We are building a legacy.
shortDescription: A campaign to rebuild Norma's family home in Riacho He Hé, Formosa, with every expense published.
longDescription: La Casa de Norma is a campaign to rebuild the family home of Norma, one of the first social communicators of Riacho He Hé, in the province of Formosa, Argentina. Gifts arrive by bank transfer and every expense is published with its date and whether a receipt exists. When the house is finished, the project continues as Fundación Norma, offering free training in digital tools.
status: Campaign open to raise the funds for the reconstruction.
